description: Per-error-type fix configuration for every error type currently referenced by the deployment autofix system (scripts/deployment-autofix.mjs, scripts/fix-all.mjs, eslint.config.js, scripts/error-research-catalog.json). Each entry is one concrete, executable error type — not a family — with its exact repair strategy, autofix eligibility, and verification method. This file is the single source of truth; validate-error-research.mjs checks it stays in sync with the live ESLint config and fix-all.mjs handler list.

policy.autoFixable: Safe to apply unattended: official tool fixer, or a position-verified mechanical rewrite with syntax-gate + rollback.
policy.handlerRequired: A concrete mechanical handler exists (native in fix-all.mjs or an external script) but only applies when the diagnostic position matches exactly; otherwise skipped, never guessed.
policy.manualRequired: No safe mechanical rewrite exists; the deployment gate reports and blocks, a human or explicit source edit is required.
policy.reportOnly: Verification/observability signal, not a coding error to rewrite.

researchFamilies.note: Broad categories researched from authoritative sources; see scripts/error-research-catalog.json for prevention/verification detail and source URLs.

TS7006.verify: tsc split-config recount must not increase

TS18046.action: Wrap identifier as '(x as any)' only when a member/call/index access follows at that exact column
TS18046.verify: tsc split-config recount must not increase

TS2571.verify: tsc split-config recount must not increase

TS18047.action: Insert '!' only when the exact expression text sits at the diagnostic column and a member/call/index access follows
TS18047.verify: tsc split-config recount must not increase

TS18048.verify: tsc split-config recount must not increase

TS6133.message: 'x' is declared but its value is never read
TS6133.action: Remove the single unused named import specifier, or the whole import line when it was the only binding
TS6133.verify: tsc split-config recount must not increase

TS2307.action: Resolve the unique existing candidate path on disk and rewrite the relative import; never invented paths

TS2339.message: Property does not exist on type
TS2339.action: Position-verified cast only at the exact reported member access
TS2339.verify: tsc split-config recount must not increase

TS2345.message: Argument type not assignable to parameter type
TS2345.verify: tsc split-config recount must not increase

TS2353.message: Object literal may only specify known properties
TS2353.action: Schema drift must be resolved against the live database (see postgres family), never guessed

TS2551.message: Property does not exist; did you mean 'y'?
TS2551.action: Rename back to the verified existing identifier only
TS2551.verify: tsc split-config recount must not increase

TS2724.message: Module has no exported member; did you mean 'y'?
TS2724.verify: tsc split-config recount must not increase

TS2769.verify: tsc split-config recount must not increase

TS1xxx (parser errors).action: Mechanical handlers refuse to run while parser errors are present in the diagnostics batch; fix syntax by hand first
TS1xxx (parser errors).verify: esbuild syntax gate per touched file

TS18049.action: Combined null+undefined case is not handled by the native TS18047/TS18048 handlers (they match single-cause messages only); add an explicit guard or default at the site
TS18049.verify: tsc split-config recount must not increase

TS2300.action: Two declarations collide; rename or remove the redundant one after confirming which is live

TS2304.action: Missing import or type declaration; add the correct import, never a global ambient stub to silence it

TS2305.action: Check the actual export list (and, for Drizzle schema fields, the live database) before adding or renaming; never invent an export

TS2322.message: Type is not assignable to type
TS2322.action: Genuine type mismatch; narrow or correct the source value's type, never widen with 'any'

TS2341.message: Property is private and only accessible within its class
TS2341.action: Add a public accessor or call the intended public API instead of reaching into a private member

TS2344.message: Type does not satisfy the constraint
TS2344.action: Generic type argument violates a library constraint; usually a version drift against @types — verify the library's real prop set

TS2349.action: Caller assumed a function where the type is not one; check for a misnamed import or an object where a method was expected

TS2351.action: A 'new' call target isn't a constructor type; check for a factory function used with 'new' by mistake

TS2352.message: Conversion of type may be a mistake
TS2352.action: Two-step cast risk; verify the intermediate 'unknown' cast is actually intended, don't blindly keep both casts

TS2362.message: Left-hand side of arithmetic operation must be number/bigint/enum
TS2362.action: Operand is typed as something non-numeric (often 'unknown' from JSONB); add an explicit numeric parse/guard

TS2363.message: Right-hand side of arithmetic operation must be number/bigint/enum
TS2363.action: Same as TS2362 for the right operand

TS2365.message: Operator cannot be applied to types
TS2365.action: Comparing incompatible types; verify which side has the wrong type rather than casting either away

TS2367.action: Likely a stale literal-union comparison after a type was narrowed elsewhere; confirm the intended branch and fix the comparison, don't silence it

TS2395.message: Individual declarations in merged declaration must be all exported or all local
TS2395.action: Class/namespace merge has mixed export modifiers; make them consistent

TS2411.message: Property type not assignable to index signature
TS2411.action: Widen the index signature type or narrow the property; a genuine shape mismatch

TS2416.message: Property not assignable to same property in base type
TS2416.action: Subclass/wrapper method signature must match its base type exactly; fix the override signature

TS2430.action: Custom request/interface augmentation conflicts with the library's own type; fix the augmentation, don't disable the check

TS2440.message: Import declaration conflicts with local declaration
TS2440.action: Same name imported and declared locally; rename one

TS2448.message: Block-scoped variable used before its declaration
TS2448.action: Real temporal-dead-zone bug; reorder the declaration above its use

TS2454.message: Variable is used before being assigned
TS2454.action: Real control-flow bug (e.g. a code path skips assignment); add the missing assignment or default

TS2488.message: Type must have a Symbol.iterator method
TS2488.action: Attempted to spread/iterate a non-iterable (often 'unknown' from JSON); narrow the type first

TS2503.action: Missing @types package or wrong import style for a namespace-only library; install/import correctly

TS2531.action: Distinct from the native TS18047 handler's exact message text; add an explicit null guard at the site

TS2532.action: Distinct from the native TS18048 handler's exact message text; add an explicit undefined guard

TS2538.message: Type 'null' cannot be used as an index type
TS2538.action: Guard the index expression against null before using it as a key

TS2554.message: Expected N arguments, but got M
TS2554.action: Call-site argument count drifted from the function signature; fix whichever side is stale

TS2556.message: Spread argument must have a tuple type or be passed to a rest parameter
TS2556.action: Give the spread source a tuple type or adjust the call target's parameter list

TS2558.message: Expected 0 type arguments, but got N
TS2558.action: Remove the stray generic argument or fix the target type's generic arity

TS2559.message: Type has no properties in common with target type
TS2559.action: Object literal shape doesn't match a Drizzle insert/update type at all; verify the correct column set against the live schema

TS2561.message: Object literal may only specify known properties (did you mean 'y'?)
TS2561.action: Apply the suggested rename only after confirming it against the live schema/type, not blindly

TS2604.message: JSX element type does not have construct or call signatures
TS2604.action: Icon/component import resolved to a non-component value (often a default-vs-named import mismatch)

TS2614.message: Module has no exported member (did you mean default import?)
TS2614.action: Switch the import between named and default form per the suggestion, verified against the module's actual exports

TS2673.message: Constructor is private and only accessible within its class
TS2673.action: Use the class's public factory/singleton accessor instead of 'new'

TS2677.message: Type predicate's type must be assignable to its parameter's type
TS2677.action: Fix the type-guard function's declared predicate type to match its parameter

TS2678.message: Type is not comparable to type
TS2678.action: Comparing against a literal absent from the union (e.g. an unhandled Stripe webhook event name); add the case or fix the literal

TS2683.action: Add an explicit 'this' parameter type to the function

TS2694.action: Stale global augmentation against a Node/@types version that changed shape; update the augmentation

TS2698.message: Spread types may only be created from object types
TS2698.action: Narrow the spread source to a known object type before spreading

TS2717.message: Subsequent property declarations must have the same type
TS2717.action: Two ambient/global augmentations declare the same property with drifting types; unify them

TS2719.message: Two different types with this name exist but are unrelated
TS2719.action: Duplicate ambient type declarations (often from two @types packages); consolidate to one source

TS2721.message: Cannot invoke an object which is possibly 'null'
TS2721.action: Guard the callable reference against null before invoking

TS2722.message: Cannot invoke an object which is possibly 'undefined'
TS2722.action: Guard the callable reference against undefined before invoking

TS2739.message: Type is missing properties from target type
TS2739.action: Object literal is missing required fields; add them with real values, never stub defaults that misrepresent state

TS2740.message: Type is missing properties from target type (array-shaped)
TS2740.action: A single object is being assigned where an array type is expected (or vice versa); fix the actual shape mismatch

TS2741.message: Property is missing in type but required in type
TS2741.action: Add the missing case/property with real handling, not a placeholder

TS2783.message: Property is specified more than once, so this usage will be overwritten
TS2783.action: Remove the duplicate key or merge the two intended values; a real overwrite bug

TS2786.message: Cannot be used as a JSX component
TS2786.action: Same class as TS2604 (icon/component import mismatch); fix the import form

TS6138.message: Property is declared but its value is never read
TS6138.action: Class-field variant of TS6133; the native handler only targets identifiers/imports, not class properties — remove or prefix with '_' by hand

TS6192.message: All imports in import declaration are unused
TS6192.action: Remove the entire unused import statement

TS6196.message: Type is declared but never used
TS6196.action: Type-alias variant of TS6133; the native handler targets value imports/identifiers, not type declarations — remove by hand

TS7005.action: Add an explicit array element type at the declaration

TS7016.message: Could not find a declaration file for module
TS7016.action: Install the package's @types, or add a minimal local .d.ts — never a blanket 'any' module wildcard

TS7022.message: Implicitly has type because it is referenced in its own initializer
TS7022.action: Self-referential initializer; add an explicit type annotation to break the inference cycle

TS7031.message: Binding element implicitly has an 'any' type
TS7031.action: Destructuring-parameter variant of TS7006; the native handler targets plain parameters, not binding patterns — add an explicit type by hand

TS7034.message: Variable implicitly has type 'any[]' in some locations where its type cannot be determined
TS7034.action: Add an explicit array type at the variable's declaration site

TS7053.message: Element implicitly has an 'any' type because expression can't be used to index type
TS7053.action: Add an index signature to the target type or use a properly-typed key lookup instead of a bare literal/number index

no-unsafe-optional-chaining.action: Requires reordering short-circuit logic (e.g. destructure after a null check, or default the whole expression) — not eligible for a blind text rewrite because the safe form depends on surrounding control flow
no-unsafe-optional-chaining.verify: npx eslint . --quiet must not report this rule at the touched line

no-undef.action: Declare the correct runtime global set per file scope (CommonJS/Node, AudioWorkletGlobalScope, Cloudflare Worker) instead of rewriting source; a real undefined identifier remains manualRequired

@typescript-eslint/no-non-null-asserted-.action: Replace 'a?.b!' with a real narrowing guard; a mechanical fix would hide the same unsafe assumption ESLint is flagging

@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars.fixer: native:fix-all.mjs applyNativeHandlers (TS6133 path) or eslint --fix underscore rename
@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars.action: Prefix with '_' or remove the binding

@typescript-eslint/no-unused-expressions.action: Statement was likely meant as an assignment or call; requires reading intent, not a safe rewrite

no-script-url.action: javascript: URL strings are a real code-injection risk class; remove or replace the vector, never auto-rewritten

no-eval.action: eval() use must be replaced with an explicit non-evaluating implementation

no-self-assign.action: Indicates a real bug (parameter shadowing outer variable of the same name); needs a rename, not a deletion

no-division-by-zero/no-division-by-zero.action: Official rule fixer wraps the divisor as '(divisor || 1)'

eqeqeq.action: Official ESLint fixer; warn-level with 'smart' option during the hardening rollout

no-useless-assignment.action: Warning-level by design during the hardening rollout; ratchet to error once triaged

preserve-caught-error.action: Warning-level; flags catch blocks that drop the original error instead of chaining it

no-console.action: Warning-level outside tests/scripts; allowed methods are warn/error

no-implied-eval.action: String-form setTimeout/setInterval/Function-constructor call must be rewritten as a real function reference; same injection risk class as no-eval

no-new-func.action: Replace `new Function(...)` with an explicit non-evaluating implementation

no-return-assign.action: Warning-level; likely `return x = y` typo for `return x === y` or `return (x = y)` intent — needs the author's intended comparison, not a blind rewrite

no-empty.action: Warning-level, allowEmptyCatch:true; only a real bare empty block (not catch) is worth reviewing

no-async-promise-executor.action: Warning-level; an async Promise executor swallows rejections — refactor to resolve/reject explicitly, not mechanical

no-constant-condition.action: Warning-level, checkLoops:false so intentional `while(true)` is allowed; only non-loop constant conditions are worth reviewing

no-misleading-character-class.action: Warning-level; regex likely doesn't match intended Unicode grapheme — needs a human to confirm the intended character set

no-irregular-whitespace.fixer: manual whitespace normalization or eslint --fix where supported

no-fallthrough.action: Warning-level; missing `break`/`return` in a switch case is a real control-flow bug, needs the author's intended case boundaries

no-dupe-else-if.action: Dead branch from a real logic error; must be corrected by reviewing the intended condition

@typescript-eslint/no-namespace.action: Warning-level during the hardening rollout; TS `namespace` usage flagged for eventual ES module migration

baselineCorrectnessRules.note: Remaining rules enabled via eslint:recommended / @typescript-eslint recommended baseline (verified programmatically by scripts/validate-error-research.mjs against the live flat config, see checkedAgainstLiveConfig). None of these have a bespoke autofixer in this repo: a genuine violation is a real correctness bug (unreachable code, redeclaration, invalid regex, etc.) that must be fixed at the offending statement by editing the source, never mechanically rewritten. `no-unsafe-optional-chaining` is intentionally excluded here because it is handled explicitly above given its 587-site volume.

liveTsSnapshot.note: scripts/validate-error-research.mjs runs a fresh split typecheck against these tsconfigs at validation time — not a committed snapshot file, which previously went 24 days stale with nothing to notice — so diagnostic-code coverage is always checked against the code as it stands right now.

externalHandlers.targets: Drizzle table object optional-chain access sites

runtimeAndInfra.note: Non-static error types the research families cover; these are verified via live signals, not source rewrites.

postgres-connection-timeout.verify: connection pool retry with backoff; alert if sustained

postgres-constraint-violation.verify: schema/data correction against the live database, never a type cast

bullmq-stalled-job.verify: handler must be idempotent so BullMQ's own stall-recovery restart is safe

http-5xx-from-dependency.verify: circuit breaker state + bounded retry on idempotent calls only

stripe-webhook-signature-failure.verify: reject and audit; never accept an unverifiable event

oom-exit-137.verify: heap snapshot / diagnostic report; never treated as a passing check

deploy-image-size-exceeded.verify: script/build.ts's pre-flight size check (post capsule-pack, pre-push) measures the project root and names the largest top-level contributor before the platform's own opaque 'image size is over the limit' rejection; investigate why the named directory grew (dependency bloat, an uncompressed generated asset, a new large binary) and shrink/exclude/capsule-pack it, never raise the budget to paper over growth

build-command-failure.verify: vite/esbuild bundling errors in script/build.ts are real compilation failures in application code, never mechanically rewritten; run `npm run build` locally, read the reported file/line, and fix the source
